consumer: pickup.cpp::handle_problematic_pickup, which presents a Wear/Wield/Empty/Skip uilist and asks the player which disposal action to take for the too-heavy item via amenu.query().
scope: only the single item being picked up plus the character's own state (is_armor, is_armed, can_wear) — the per-item interactive choice, not a map region.
decisive_source: src/pickup.cpp::handle_problematic_pickup — builds a uilist of WEAR/WIELD/EMPTY entries gated on can_wear/is_armed and calls amenu.query() through the real active input loop to get the player's decision.
divergence: Pick up a too-heavy armor item while already wielding a weapon: the menu must offer an enabled WEAR entry (only if can_wear succeeds) and a 'Dispose of and wield' entry; a backend that silently defaults instead of driving the query would resolve disposal without the player's actual choice, producing a wrong end state.
